A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ECALP research. The text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original zero-shot and few-shot classification experiments, component ablations, computational timings, and appendix robustness and failure analyses.

after.justification: v2 reports original classification experiments, including revised style-transfer accuracies, and retains the empirical ablations, timings, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The dynamic graph expansion, iterative propagation with label resetting, incremental labels, and context-aware reweighting remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 only receives wording and notation edits.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same 11 fine-grained benchmarks, four reported ImageNet style-transfer variants, and 15 ImageNet-C corruption types. Appendix corruption-severity and hard-samples-first scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and figures, including DMN/DMN*, TDA, ZLaP, prompt-tuning baselines, and the few-shot APE, TIP-Adapter, and TIP-X comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported backbones, split and prompt sources, graph hyperparameters, propagation iterations, and 1/2/4/8/16-shot evaluation remain unchanged. Appendix sensitivity ranges, corruption severities, and stream-initialization procedures are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the component and graph ablations, KNN and iteration sensitivity, static-versus-dynamic timing, CoOp combination, corruption-severity tests, initialization robustness, and t-SNE failure analysis. No substantive analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report point accuracies and timings without disclosed repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. Uncertainty-reporting practices do not change.

E6.justification: Under unchanged reported settings, Table 2 revises eight ECALP dataset accuracies and both means: RN50 47.70 to 47.73 and ViT-B/16 64.88 to 64.92. Section 4.2 replaces the claimed 24% RN50 gain with an approximately 7% average gain. Other numerical results and rankings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and complexity derivations remain substantively unchanged. Equation 1 makes identity-matrix notation explicit by replacing 1 with I; deleting Appendix A.1.3 removes a redundant summary while retaining its derivations and conclusions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: training-free adaptation through dynamic label propagation, context-aware reweighting, efficient inductive inference, and strong downstream performance.

C2.justification: The explanations of manifold exploitation, reweighting, initialization robustness, and few-shot failures remain unchanged. The revised gain sentence corrects numerical reporting without changing the scientific interpretation or applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: v2 adds an abstract statement that source code is available and supplies an ECALP repository link, absent from v1. Hyperparameters, hardware, and data-processing references remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to prior adaptation and label-propagation methods remain unchanged. Updates to Brown et al. (2020) and Fei-Fei et al. (2004) concern metadata for already cited works.

P1.justification: v2 copyedits wording and terminology, adds author-contribution and acknowledgment information, corrects the Appendix A.2.3 reference from Table 1 to Table 8, and removes the repeated complexity summary. The main narrative and section order are retained.

P2.justification: Existing appendix figures and tables are repositioned relative to surrounding text, and conference headers and page layout change. Table 3 receives revised caption terminology, while figure contents, axes, legends, and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the unsupported 24% RN50 gain description to approximately 7%, consistent with the roughly seven-percentage-point difference in Table 2. The corrected appendix cross-reference, copyediting, and newly documented code access improve accuracy and usability. The method and supporting analyses remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
